run_AVAVisualizerWithPrecomputedBox: run the AVAVisualizerWithPrecomputedBox class to visualize action predictions on a video with precomputed bounding boxes
load_boxes_labels: load bounding boxes and labels from AVA-format CSV files for a given video and configuration
merge_pred_gt_boxes: merge precomputed prediction boxes and ground-truth boxes into a unified dictionary keyed by frame index
get_input_clip: get a formatted input clip from a video for a given keyframe index by extracting and scaling frames
get_predictions: run the SlowFast model on precomputed boxes to generate action prediction scores for each box
